title: The sidewalk becomes a screen
governingQuestion: When a private show reaches a public screen, which barrier has actually moved?

beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: New York makes time itself operational: calendar authority, dispersed venues, capture, broadcast, production labor, orders and memory must coordinate. This chapter follows circulation: A public stream can widen technical access while ranking systems, language, bandwidth and platform ownership continue to govern attention.
beats.onScreen: Then: CFDA launched RUNWAY360 with support for livestreams, AR/VR, 360-degree media and social integrations during the September 2020 digital pivot.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: CFDA launched RUNWAY360 with support for livestreams, AR/VR, 360-degree media and social integrations during the September 2020 digital pivot. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: In September 2025, CFDA and Rockefeller Center announced public NYFW streams at the Rink and Channel Gardens, supported by Genesys.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: No equivalent public-screen partnership for September 2026 is assumed until an organizer or venue publishes one.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger
